provider: Yandex Mail — 5 GB pooled with Disk, 1 GB attachment

free_tier.stated: Yandex's own docs: "By default, users without a plan get 5 GB of storage space." Mail and Disk now share one pool: "Emails and attachments in Yandex Mail now share storage with files on Yandex Disk." Attachment cap: "The maximum attachment size is 1 GB. You can add larger files to messages only if you have a Yandex 360 plan."

retention.stated: Documented over-quota decay: attachments above 25 MB are blocked; at 44 days sending and reading mail are blocked and Disk is blocked; at 90 days the Disk may be cleared and files are not recoverable. Trash items are removed automatically after 30 days.

tooling: IMAP probe-verified: `imap.yandex.com:993` -> `* OK Yandex IMAP4rev1 at imap.yandex.ru:993 ready` / `* CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 CHILDREN UNSELECT LITERAL+ NAMESPACE XLIST UIDPLUS ENABLE ID AUTH=PLAIN AUTH=XOAUTH2 MOVE`. SMTP: `250-SIZE 53477376` = 51 MiB.
chaining: 5 GB × N accounts. The 1 GB attachment cap makes it look generous per message, but the pool is 5 GB, so one attachment is 20% of the account.
limits_note: Per-object-cap 1 GB attachment (docs) but SMTP SIZE says 51 MiB. The 1 GB path is a Disk-upload link, not an SMTP attachment, so again link-vs-storage. Pool is 5 GB shared with Disk. Hard retention decay ladder documented: full -> attach >25 MB blocked; 44 days -> cannot send/read; 90 days -> Disk may be cleared, files unrecoverable.
reliability_note: The most explicit data-loss ladder of any provider here. 90 days over quota and Disk is wiped. Never use as primary copy.

evidence.proved: probe: smtp.yandex.com:587 -> 250-SIZE 53477376; probe: imap.yandex.com:993 -> * OK Yandex IMAP4rev1 ready
Mail and Disk share one 5 GB pool, confirming the stated free tier

evidence.proved: the 1 GB attachment cap is confirmed on the first-party mail page
evidence.quote: The maximum attachment size is 1 GB. You can add larger files to messages only if you have a Yandex 360 plan.

evidence.proved: the 90-day Disk wipe and 25 MB attachment threshold are documented on the first-party mail storage page
evidence.quote: If the restrictions are not lifted within 90 days, you may lose large email attachments. This is because attachments larger than 25 MB are stored on Yandex Disk, and Yandex Disk is completely cleared after 90 days of being blocked.
